# GOAL explainer, shot list (v1.8)

Rebuild reference for the 45 second motion explainer in `goal-explainer.html`. v1.5 added a desktop browser window beside the phone in scenes 2 and 4, a cursor that clicks on desktop, and moved every "Paid" mark onto the clicks in scene 3 so leads never carry a paid label. v1.6 moved the whole piece to the new site's dark scheme and added a clean autoplay build (`goal-explainer-autoplay.html`) with no control bar and no captions. v1.7 matched the new site exactly: its Sora and Outfit type, its #057BE5 blue, its card and button styling, and its animated grid texture behind every scene. v1.8 adds a portrait stage for phones. Stage is 1920 by 1080. Times are from the start of the piece (global) with the scene local time in parentheses. All durations are in milliseconds unless marked.

## Global spec

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Frame | Landscape 1920 by 1080, 16:9, scaled to fit the viewport. On a viewport taller than it is wide the page switches to a portrait stage of 1080 by 1920 (9:16) with the same five scenes reflowed into one column: text block on top, devices or groups below, everything centered vertically. For video, render the landscape frame as the master and the portrait frame as a second deliverable for phones and social. |
| Type | Sora weight 800 for headlines, recap lines and the tagline (the site's heading face). Outfit for everything else (eyebrows, labels, counters, captions, form text), weights 400 to 800. Headlines 58px, tracking -0.02em, line height 1.1. Scene 1 headline 66px, scene 4 headline 56px. Eyebrows 28px weight 700 uppercase, tracking 0.08em, blue #057BE5. UI labels 28px. Counters weight 900 tabular numerals in white (96px in scene 2, 112px in scene 3) with the "of 10" in blue, like the site's white figures with blue accents. Captions 32px weight 500. Nothing under 28px on the stage. |
| Color | Taken from the new site's tokens. Background #080C10 (brand-darkest) on every scene. Cards, the form panel and the caption strip #0D1117 (brand-darker) with a 1px rgba(30,41,59,0.6) border, 12px radius and the site's card shadow 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25). Inner tiles #151A1E (brand-dark). Headlines white, body text #B8C4D0, muted #94A3B8, non-converting clicks #475569, device bezels #334155. Primary blue #057BE5 for dots, eyebrows, the "of 10", buttons, the closing button, the flying "Paid click" chip and the grid highlight; hover #0D6EFD. Light blue #339FFF for chips, receipt checks and the scene 5 check marks. Buttons are 12px radius with the site's blue shadow 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(5,123,229,0.25). Device screens stay white with the light palette inside them (ink #0F1B2D, body #2B3442, muted #6A7482, lines #E3E8EF). No magenta, and no violet: the site has none, the violet seen in some screenshots is a color shift in the capture, not a brand color. |
| Chrome | Top bar 96px tall: white wordmark at left, 36px tall, 96px from the left edge (hidden on scenes 1 and 5). Five progress segments at right, each 112 by 6px, 10px gap, track rgba(255,255,255,0.18) with a blue fill that grows across the active scene. Caption bar 112px tall at the bottom, #0D1117 with a faint top border and the site's 1px blue glow line centered on it, caption in #B8C4D0. In the autoplay build the caption bar is hidden and each scene centers in the full frame. |
| Standard entrance | Rise 12px and fade in over 450ms, ease-out cubic (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), elements staggered 80ms in reading order. |
| Beat swap | Outgoing headline fades out and lifts 10px over 350ms. Incoming headline rises in 450ms, starting 350ms after the outgoing begins. |
| Grid texture | The site's hero lattice, redrawn on a canvas behind every scene and driven by the master clock. 28px cells of 0.6px lines at rgba(255,255,255,0.05) with 1px white points at 10 percent. A soft highlight drifts across the frame: x = 0.28 + 0.16 sin(0.21t), y = 0.42 + 0.18 sin(0.13t + 1.2) as fractions of the frame, t in seconds, radius 28 percent of the frame's long side. Points near it brighten toward blue (alpha up to 0.9, size up to 3.2px), the lines between them turn blue (alpha up to 0.55, width up to 1.3px), and the lattice bows outward by up to 27px around it. In the HTML the highlight also follows the pointer. Hidden in scroll view; static in reduced motion. |
| Device pair | A 940 by 800 composite. Desktop browser window 760 by 600 at top left: white, 1px #E3E8EF border, 16px radius, 56px title bar in #F8FAFC with three 12px gray dots and a 300 by 28 address pill, content column 504px wide. Phone 380 by 760 at bottom right, in front of the window's right edge, 3px ink outline, 52px radius. Both carry shadow 0 4px 14px rgba(0,23,45,0.08). |
| Cursor | 40px arrow pointer, white fill, 2px ink stroke with rounded joins, soft drop shadow. Travels on a shallow arc (24px lift), ease in-out. A click is a 240ms press (scale 1 to 0.85 to 1) with the tap dot and a small ring (84px) at the tip. |
| Tap | Blue 24px dot with a 4px white halo scales from 0.4 to 1 over 220ms. A 120px ring (3px blue stroke) expands from scale 0.25 to 1.2 and fades from 60 percent to 0 over 700ms. The dot shrinks away over 300ms, 900ms after the tap. |
| Checks | Inline SVG check, 2px to 2.5px rounded stroke. Draws along its path over 420 to 450ms, ease-out. |
| Icons | One line set, 2px rounded strokes: check, search, inbox, form. |
| Assets | goal-mark.png (radar mark, 400px wide), goal-wordmark-black.png, goal-wordmark-white.png. Logos only fade or scale in (never recolored, stretched, rotated). Keep clear space around them. |
| Audio | None. Designed to be understood with sound off. |

## Notes for the editor

- Every beat is 12 words or fewer. The only figure in the piece is "6 in 10".
- Scene 3 must show exactly six blue lead cards and four light gray non-converting clicks. Every "Paid" mark lives in the clicks row at the left; lead cards and the gray group carry no paid label, because the agency pays for the click and the lead is what some clicks turn into.
- The blue dot is the continuity device: the click dot under the cursor and the thumb in scene 2, the ten traveling dots in scene 3, the dot on each lead card in scene 4.
- Desktop and phone always act together: the ad lands on both screens, a cursor clicks on desktop while a thumb taps on the phone, and in scene 4 both forms fill at once and each produces its own lead.
- The footnote in scene 4 stays small, muted and calm. It appears only in the last three seconds of the scene.
- Cuts between scenes are hard cuts; the shared chrome carries the eye on light scenes. Add a 200ms dip only if the video platform requires one.
- Form values are placeholders. Replace with other generic values if needed, but never with real customer data.
